# Griffith Creative

> Griffith Creative is a web design and infrastructure firm in Los Angeles, founded in 2020, working worldwide. We design and build websites, keep them running, and help companies build the systems they run on.

## Services

- [Design and build](https://www.griffithcreative.co/services): Custom websites, designed and written in house, built on a static-first stack and served from the edge. Scoped to the business and quoted in writing.
- [Enterprise](https://www.griffithcreative.co/enterprise): Rebuilds, migrations, and ongoing management for high-traffic sites and the companies behind them.
- [Systems](https://www.griffithcreative.co/systems): Storage, software, and workflows reviewed and rebuilt around how a team actually works.
- [Care Plan](https://www.griffithcreative.co/care): A monthly plan for sites we build. Updates, hosting, monitoring, and priority support.
